narr: Thunderstorms developed into northwestern Arkansas during the early morning hours of the 18th. Unusually high moisture content of the air, and slow-moving thunderstorms resulted in locally heavy rainfall and flash flooding.
ev: Flood water caused minor damage to twenty homes in Ozark, and damaged portions of several roads in southwestern Franklin County.
lsr: MINOR DAMAGE TO APPROXIMATELY 20 HOMES IN OZARK WITH WATER IN THEM. SOME ROADS DAMAGED DUE TO HIGH WATER IN SW FRANKLIN COUNTY. TIME IS APPROXIMATE.
